subject: Orchestration strike team: OKR check-in and QBR prep for activation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Helen Kapoor <helen.kapoor@atlashealth.com>
Cc: alice@cottongrove.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchestration strike team: OKR check-in and QBR prep for activation

Team,

Heading into the final sprint before our activation window, I want a concise status snapshot tied to the QBR narrative. Objective: surface any risks that would materially change launch timing or SLA commitments so leadership can triage before Friday's review.

Ask (one-line per workstream):
- GTM (Marissa): current campaign & enablement cadence ready? key open items?
- Pricing & Contracts (Laura): any outstanding legal/procurement holds with pilot partners?
- Docs & Training (Grace/Monica): Is the enablement playbook published and are training slots filled?
- Support & Ops (Vivek): expected on-call coverage and escalation playbook complete?

Please reply with a 2–4 line update per bullet by EOD Thursday (2027-07-22). I will consolidate into the QBR deck and flag anything that needs leadership escalation. Helen — copying AtlasHealth so they see the timeline; appreciate any procurement constraints you want surfaced.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Orchestration, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Kapoor <helen.kapoor@atlashealth.com>, alice@cottongrove.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration strike team: OKR check-in and QBR prep for activation

Karthik — quick GTM/status update below. Attaching a short readiness checklist (see attachments) and the draft campaign timeline.

GTM (Marissa):
- Campaign assets 90% (final copy reviews finishing 7/22).
- Demo environment slots booked with pilot accounts; Helen confirmed 3 executive demo windows next week.
- Contingency: if docs bundle slips >48h, we will run a trimmed enablement for sales (one-pager + live walkthrough).

Enablement (Grace/Monica):
- Playbook landing page is up; recorded modules pending final edit (~24–36h).
- Training slots: 4 internal sessions scheduled (7/25, 7/26), 2 customer-facing workshops (7/28).

Open asks for leadership/QBR narrative:
- Need note on pricing guardrails (Laura) to include in QBR cost vs. revenue projections.
- Confirm SLA target to show in deck (Vivek) — currently projecting 99.5% for hosted API in pilot region.

Attachments: playbook-activation-runbooks.pdf (runbook stub), qbr-deck-draft.pptx (v0.6)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Growth & GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Helen Kapoor <helen.kapoor@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration strike team: OKR check-in and QBR prep for activation

Thanks — short legal/pricing & procurement update:
- AtlasHealth pilot: SOW signed pending standard indemnity language adjustment (legal expects to close by 7/26). Procurement asked for a one-line confirmation on data retention window; Helen, can you confirm AtlasHealth's desired retention term?
- Pricing: proposing a pilot credit program (one-time activation credit) to remove friction for early adopters. Will include revenue impact slide for QBR; draft numbers attached in the OKR snapshot sheet.

Operational question for Vivek: if we expose the pilot to two additional accounts (Cotton Grove + MedSolutions procurement), do we need an uplift in on-call headcount next month? If yes, we should call that out in the QBR as a near-term incremental cost.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Kapoor <helen.kapoor@atlashealth.com>, procurement@medsolutions.com, alice@cottongrove.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration strike team: OKR check-in and QBR prep for activation

Team — consolidated readout and next steps for QBR Friday: 

Decisions & status (short):
- GTM: campaign goes live 7/29 internal, customer comms 8/02. Assets complete by close of day 7/22 as reported. Owner: Marissa.
- Enablement: playbook landing + recordings will be published by 7/24; customer workshops remain 7/28. Owner: Grace w/ Monica.
- Pricing/Contracts: SOW language near-final; Laura to confirm indemnity change and retention term by 7/26. If procurement asks for longer retention, we will note incremental cost in the QBR. Owner: Laura.
- Support & Ops: Vivek confirms current on-call capacity covers pilot at 2 accounts; adding a 3rd account requires an additional 0.2 FTE on-call coverage. Action: Vivek to produce an incremental cost estimate by 7/29. Owner: Vivek.

QBR artifacts I will attach to the deck: 2027Q3-OKR-snapshot.xlsx (OKR rollup + impact), qbr-deck-draft.pptx (v0.7), playbook-activation-runbooks.pdf (runbook extracts). Please treat these as working drafts — any major edits, flag inline comments in the Drive link before 7/28 12:00pm PT.

Helen — thanks for the procurement visibility. If AtlasHealth needs a retention term confirmed, Laura will reach out directly.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Marissa: finalize assets and send final campaign one-pager (due 7/22 EOD).
- Grace/Monica: publish recordings and confirm customer workshop invites (due 7/24).
- Laura: finalize SOW language and retention reply to Atlas (due 7/26).
- Vivek: incremental on-call cost estimate if we add 3rd account (due 7/29).
- Karthik: consolidate QBR slides and send final pack to leadership (due 7/30).

If there are no major blockers, I will present the activation section in the QBR and highlight the pilot ramp assumptions and cost sensitivities. Thanks, everyone — concise updates were extremely helpful.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Orchestration, Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2027Q3-OKR-snapshot.xlsx (sheet stub), qbr-deck-draft.pptx (v0.7 stub), playbook-activation-runbooks.pdf (runbook extracts)
